name: Loving As Jesus Loved
overview: Scripture calls believers to love others deeply and sacrificially, modeling the love that Jesus demonstrated. Leviticus commands us not to seek revenge but to love our neighbors as ourselves, reflecting God's holy standard. The Psalmist celebrates God's unfailing lovingkindness and faithfulness, which believers are called to proclaim openly. Jesus then gives a new commandment to love one another just as He has loved us, setting the highest example for Christian love rooted in selflessness and grace.
